model.score_convention: Ultralytics detector confidence; not a calibrated image-level PASS probability
model.preprocessing: uint8 BGR -> Ultralytics aspect-preserving letterbox imgsz=640; original-pixel xyxy output; no EXIF transform on incoming frames
model.rejection: Only learned non_catalogue detection; complete open-set rejection not validated

size_tolerance.allowance_basis: Explicit user proposal in this session; not supplier manufacturing tolerance or confirmed measurement uncertainty
size_tolerance.iso_din_assignment: UNCONFIRMED; do not infer standards from generic M4/M5 or image dimensions

class_zero.meaning: outside five permitted classes and/or sizes

notes: Supplier values describe the intended purchased product; photographed specimen identity/caliper dimensions are not yet independently confirmed.
Do not replace washer inner diameter 5.0 with generic standard reference 5.3.
Packaging counts 50/100 are not inspection expected_counts and are deliberately excluded.
Additional head diameters are descriptive references, not new acceptance gates.
Use existing candidate x/y scales and approximate coplanar assumption; never calibrate from these product renderings.
Geometric candidates, missing/unsupported dimensions and all comparisons remain REVIEW; no automatic PASS/FAIL.

model.decision_stage: confirmed rejection/count mismatch -> FAIL; incomplete evidence -> REVIEW; all gates -> PASS
model.size_verification: P06 measurements; provisional unless calibration, scope and acceptance are confirmed
model.rejection_validation: Foreground/physical validation required; no automatic claim of complete unknown rejection
model.rule_rejection_score_convention: Size-confirmed non-catalogue objects retain the original detector score, not a fabricated class0 probability; detector_class_id/class_assignment are in diagnostics.json
model.count_decision_score: none: decision derived from observed vs expected counts; object scores unchanged
model.offline_timing: perf_counter: adapter preprocess/features/classifier/postprocess/result validation + GPU completion sync; excludes image decoding, weight load and export; not live latency
